title: Gate a VCF Installer deployment with its specification precheck
prompt: Implement the VCF Installer client workflow in installer/client.go. PrecheckAndDeploy must POST the supplied SddcSpec to the validateSddcSpec operation first and may call deploySddc only when the returned validation has executionStatus COMPLETED and resultStatus SUCCEEDED. Any HTTP error, decode error, nonterminal validation, FAILED, WARNING, UNKNOWN, or cancellation result must stop the workflow without contacting the mutating operation. Use the exact operation paths, methods, media types, and JSON field names in docs/contract.json. Do not send deploySddc's optional skipValidations query parameter when it is unset. All unset optional SddcSpec fields, including nested optional fields, must be omitted rather than serialized as empty values. Send the same JSON document to both operations, propagate the caller's context, preserve the exported error types, and decode the contract response types. Keep the implementation safe for concurrent use. Add focused table-driven tests as useful. The acceptance command is python3 .moonshiner/verifier.py, which runs the complete suite with the Go race detector. Verification uses only the supplied loopback mock; do not contact a live VMware endpoint.
